title: Atypical Neurological Presentation of Familial Mediterranean Fever Mimicking Refractory Childhood Epilepsy.
snippet: Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) is a monogenic autoinflammatory disorder classically characterized by recurrent episodes of fever and polyserositis. Although central nervous system involvement is rare, FMF can atypically present with severe neurological manifestations, including seizure disorders.
